Rajesh Khanna's Co-star Shares Experience

Actor Tej Sapru shared his experience of working with Rajesh Khanna, stating that Khanna was arrogant and used to give him gaalis (abuse) on set. Sapru attributed Khanna's downfall to his arrogance and the effects of success going to his head. This account was shared in an interview where Sapru discussed his time working with Khanna. The incident highlights the challenges of working in the film industry and the impact of fame on individuals. Khanna's behavior on set was reportedly affected by his career peak, leading to difficulties for those around him.
